Let me analyze these teaching examples carefully to identify systematic forecast errors and derive correction rules.

## Example 1 Analysis (2025-05-21)

- Sentiment: Mixed, ranging from negative to positive
- Model forecast: Starts at 72.79, gradually declines to ~68 by day 30
- True outcome: Starts at 72.74 (very close!), then diverges - the model underestimates significantly after day 4-5
